en: Here's the way down into the sewers! Pretty suspicious, don't you think? Nobody would ever look down there.
I knew it! Those rotten Pokémon thieves!
Then the only place I haven't checked yet is... the sewers! {player}, give me a hand down there!
Right! The sewers are the perfect place to hide. Go on, catch up with him!
There you are! Your friend came back up looking really cross. Did everything go all right down there?
So what now? You met Burgh in the sewers, didn't you? Then you should go and challenge his Gym. See how strong you've got!
The sewers are the perfect place to hide. Hurry, before your friend runs into trouble on his own!
Burgh's back in his Gym on Gym Street. Go and show him what you can do!
The sewers? Go on down if you must, but mind the wild Pokémon. Some Trainers go down there on purpose to train!
With the tide high, the sewers sometimes flood. It changes with the season, they say.
